english.title: Interfere / obstruct Bristol Airport / person in execution of duty at Bristol Airport / person using Bristol Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[intentionally obstructed or interfered with the proper use]_
(B)_[intentionally obstructed or interfered with a person acting in the execution of his duty in relation to the operation]_
(C)_[intentionally obstructed a person in the proper use]_

of Bristol Airport
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4.19 and 3.4 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
intentionally obstruct / interfere
with the proper use of Bristol Airport OR
a person acting in the execution of their duty in relation to the operation of Bristol Airport OR
a person in the proper use of Bristol Airport
